USE_GATEWAYS_AS_TIMERSERVERS.description: Assume service gateways function as timeservers.

FALLBACK_TIMESERVERS.description: List of fallback timeservers separated by commas.

FALLBACK_NAMESERVERS.description: List of fallback nameservers separated by commas.

DEFAULT_AUTO_CONNECT_TECHNOLOGIES.description: List of technologies marked autoconnectable by default.

PREFERRED_TECHNOLOGIES.description: List of preferred technologies separated by commas.

NETWORK_INTERFACE_BLACKLIST.description: List of blacklisted network interfaces separated by commas.

ALLOW_HOSTNAME_UPDATES.description: Allow ConnMan to change the system hostname.

ALLOW_DOMAINNAME_UPDATES.description: Allow ConnMan to change the system domainname.

SINGLE_CONNECTED_TECHNOLOGY.description: Keep only a single connected technology at any time.

TETHERING_TECHNOLOGIES.description: List of technologies for which tethering is allowed.

PERSISTENT_TETHERING_MODE.description: Restore earlier tethering status when returning from offline mode.

ONLINE_CHECK_MODE.description: Online HTTP-based Internet reachability check mode.

ENABLE_ONLINE_CHECK.description: Enable online HTTP-based Internet reachability check.

ONLINE_CHECK_IPV4_URL.description: URL used during online status check for IPv4.

ONLINE_CHECK_IPV6_URL.description: URL used during online status check for IPv6.

ONLINE_CHECK_CONNECT_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout for TCP connection to online check host in seconds.

ONLINE_CHECK_INITIAL_INTERVAL.description: Initial interval between online check requests in seconds.

ONLINE_CHECK_MAX_INTERVAL.description: Max interval between online check requests in seconds.

ENABLE_ONLINE_TO_READY_TRANSITION.description: Enable continuous online reachability checks to detect loss of connectivity.

ONLINE_CHECK_FAILURES_THRESHOLD.description: Number of failed online checks before marking service as failed.

ONLINE_CHECK_SUCCESSES_THRESHOLD.description: Number of successful online checks to clear service as failed.

ONLINE_CHECK_INTERVAL_STYLE.description: Style for computing time between online check requests.

ALWAYS_CONNECTED_TECHNOLOGIES.description: List of technologies with AutoConnect=true always connected.

AUTO_CONNECT_ROAMING_SERVICES.description: Enable auto connection of services in roaming.
